mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 68 degrees. The moon is currently full, and while there is an ISS pass tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, please note that Highway M will be closed to traffic from October 5 through October 7 for final paving and asphalt work. Also, a reminder from the Planning Department to watch for online scams requesting payments for permit fees, as the city only accepts checks for these services.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking forward, Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening September 28.
Looking at the weekly police report, on September 3, a 33-year-old man was arrested for operating while intoxicated, or O W I, second offence, after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.

It is a great day to grab a treat, as the Culver's flavor of the day is the delightful Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up scoops until they close at 10:30 PM tonight.
